title: Why Do Mosquitoes Only Attack ME?!
caption:
When you're the ONLY one getting eaten alive 😩
A mosquito squad shows up with tiny forks and knives, one poor guy gets bitten head to toe, and his final fix is a full bubble wrap suit.
Turns out they track the CO2 you breathe out and your body heat like guided missiles — some of us are just built to be the buffet.
Are you the one mosquitoes always find first? 🦟
Share this with your most-bitten friend 🫡
